device_entry.name: 泰克 TDS5xx 系列数字示波器
tags: 瞬态信号采集与同步触发测量
device_entry.description: 用于泰克 TDS5xx 系列数字示波器的控制与读出，可进行通道与参考波形访问、数学波形选择、波形传输、触发设置、水平时基调整、自动测量以及屏幕截图获取，适合实验中的电信号观测与波形分析。
device_entry.description_en: Control and readout for Tektronix TDS5xx series digitizing oscilloscopes, supporting channel and reference waveform access, math waveform selection, waveform transfer, trigger setup, horizontal timebase adjustment, automatic measurements, and screen capture for laboratory electrical signal observation and waveform analysis.
